stage: new prospective cohort experiment; preserve stage-A and all older results
channels: fixed intersection of unflagged numeric EEG channels in training-person headers only, excluding constructed reference29; verify EEG type and declared volts
bad_channel_policy: held-out source bad flags produce masks; no interpolation, performance-based deletion or replacement by zero

filter.DC_policy: subtract coefficient mean once to make coefficient sum numerically zero; disclose frequency response
filter.convolution: centered VALID within each source segment; complete finite context required; no source extension

clock: MNE canonical annotation event sample + phase-zero j=0,10,... < ceil(WAV_frames*500/WAV_rate); exact original slowed WAVs; no fitted delay/stretch
training_target: equal-person average of the four training listeners on identical source-time samples and fixed40 channels; all four must have finite supported values
primary_test_target: equal-person average of both reserved listeners on identical timestamps and channels good in both, scored equally by segment/channel
secondary_test_target: each reserved listener individually on its own documented good-channel mask; all supported results reported
preprocessing_scope: no new ICA/referencing; inherited author ICA and bad-flag estimation scope remains unknown; one narrative chapter only
test_lock: Do not decode reserved test people/segments until all candidate forecasts and metrics/comparisons are frozen. Header/channel metadata inspection is permitted and logged.
